title: The AI's room and the server
desc: The AI writes code and runs tests in its own room, with no key to the server. The server locks the tests and runs them on every change. The change goes to the server, and the server answers pass or fail.

nodes.text:
The AI's room
The AI writes code and runs tests.
It has no key to the server.
It cannot touch the locks.

The server
It locks the tests and runs them.
Nobody can change a lock.
Only a pass goes in.
